about: Report values that are public by design (docs/package_gate.md §6, N81): the value inspection does not search for them. Each entry names the value and the reason it is public. Protected, like everything under release/. The fixtures' values are chosen not to collide with the fixture site; the entries are the collisions `export collisions` found at 96be411 on the live run of stage 2.4, each approved by the Owner on 2026-11-25 (N108).

values.reason: The year of the releases recorded in site/releases.md, public by design; it is also year_number in 14 reports (P01, P02, P04 to P11, P13 to P16). Exempted, 2026 is not searched in any report: a leak of exactly that number would pass.

The label of the restricted profile in release/profiles.json (N23), which the login screen shows; it is also a category name of P15 (support_category_group). Exempted, the text Logística is not searched in any report: a leak of exactly that text would pass.
